name: Airwave Style Guide
about: Where the design authority for Airwave lives — Airwave (the player), Airwave Hub and Airwave Companion — what is generated from it, and how to check it. One guide for the three apps. Read this before changing any UI or UX.

designs.owns: How each app looks. The player is the first file served as a shell (music-player/scripts/make-shell.py writes music-player/index.html from it); the hub and the companion are drawn with stylesheets generated from the other two.

windowStylesheets.owns: What the hub and the companion wear: the window designs’ own CSS, copied out by packages/aqua-ui/scripts/make-window-css.py (pnpm build:window-css). Generated — change the design file, never these.

windowArt.owns: AquaArt: the drawn push button, pop-up and checkbox both windows wear, published as --aq-* custom properties. One module, imported as @now-playing/aqua-ui/airwave-art.

windowKits.owns: Each window’s own kit, icons and remaining styles: the design’s markup as components, the states the designs never drew, and (hub) the contrast inks. Per product on purpose (DEC-026).

tokens.owns: Documented values: colour, type, space, size, shadow, motion and the page skin for the component library; the `airwave` group records the Airwave window’s palette, which the design files own.

stylesheets.owns: The component library’s custom properties (light scheme on :root, dark and touch layers after it). Mirror tokens.json by hand; see tokenMap. Loaded by the player’s React source, the gallery and this guide — not by the hub or the companion.

tokenMap.owns: Which custom property carries each token, and recorded exceptions.

overrides.owns: Temporary trials written by the styleguide’s token editor, for the component library only. Empty in the repository.

components.owns: The component library: every shared React control, shell, overlay and state. Imported by the player’s React source in music-player/src (kept, not served — DEC-019), the gallery and this guide; it exports only what the player imports, and the styleguide’s usage scan lists any component no product imports so it can be removed. The hub and the companion import only the Airwave stylesheets and AquaArt from this package (DEC-026).

rules.owns: Interaction and content rules with stable IDs, their owning code and their tests.

coverage.owns: Every surface, state and journey, with discovery sources.

decisions.owns: Adopted, proposed and unresolved decisions and exceptions (DEC-###).

prose.owns: The reasoning behind the visuals, in long form.

conformance.owns: Spec §17/§18 MUSTs mapped to tests, reviewer checks or deviations.

shell.about: The served player, photographed at 1280 × 860 and 390 × 844 from pnpm build:player. shots.json records the hash of the shell they were taken from; pnpm styleguide:check fails when the shell has changed since.

imports: design/frontends/airwave-now-playing.html, served as music-player/index.html: imports nothing from aqua-ui
@now-playing/aqua-ui and @now-playing/aqua-ui/now-playing.css: the React source in music-player/src, kept but not served (DEC-019)

commands.build:window-css: pnpm build:window-css — regenerates airwave-window.css and airwave-hub.css from design/frontends/airwave-companion.html and airwave-hub.html.
commands.styleguide:build: pnpm styleguide:build — rebuilds docs/design/styleguide.html from the sources above (same as pnpm build:styleguide).
commands.styleguide:check: pnpm styleguide:check — sources and evidence exist, rule IDs are unique, every discovered screen is in the ledger, tokens.json matches the stylesheets (the library’s and the Airwave window’s), and the committed HTML was built from the current sources.
commands.styleguide:shell: pnpm styleguide:shell — after pnpm build:player, retakes the served player's screenshots for The served shell (packages/aqua-ui/styleguide/shell) and records which shell they show.
commands.styleguide:pdf: pnpm styleguide:pdf — prints the committed HTML to docs/design/styleguide.pdf with Playwright’s Chromium (set NP_STYLEGUIDE_BROWSER to use an installed Chrome or Edge).
commands.e2e: pnpm --filter @now-playing/aqua-ui test:e2e — measures every mockup at every size.

verification.note: Filled in by whoever last verified the guide at runtime. Source checks are automatic (styleguide:check); `runtime` records what was seen in a running product as it is now, and `superseded` keeps earlier records of interfaces that have since been replaced, which no longer count.

blocked.companion: Electron-only; its renderer needs the preload bridge. Covered by its DOM and contract tests and the mockups.
blocked.android: No Android SDK or JDK 17 on the machine that built this revision.
blocked.discord: Needs a bot token and a Discord server; covered by the voice and parity tests.
blocked.local-helper: Console output was not captured for this revision; covered by its integration tests.
blocked.hub: Not opened in a running hub since the Airwave window replaced the earlier admin GUI. Covered by its DOM, e2e, a11y and journey suites, and by the mockups.

superseded.scenario: Player dev server, empty library, no hub: each section, Settings, search with no match, the Shared segment (toast by pointer and keyboard), and one token change (--np-accent) seen in the player and the rebuilt guide, then reverted.
superseded.method: Claude browser pane with DOM measurement
superseded.why: These are the React interface’s surfaces, served then and not now: the player serves the Airwave shell (DEC-019).

superseded.scenario: Hub admin dev server against a fresh data folder: the first-run sign-in screen. Signing in was not attempted; it needs a person to enter the password.
superseded.why: The sign-in screen seen here was replaced by the Airwave Hub window, which draws sign-in inside the window (DEC-017).
